3.9 New formulation (same a.i.) for seed.one: Data for a new seed-treatment formulation when another formulation of the same a.i. is already registered for seed treatment (296th RC, 2008).

pts: Composition, adjuvant properties, specification and method, ATR, shelf-life claim and data, process
Sample with reference standard; residue method in BIS format
Different pest: two seasons, multilocation
Same pest: one season at 3–4 locations
Residue and persistence only for additional crops, vegetables, or crops eaten as young seedlings
Six acute studies, birds, fish, bees, earthworm, medical data, worker health records

3.10 FIM vs FIT u/s 9(3).one: Making in India a formulation identical to one already registered for import, with the same label claims (317th RC, 2011).

pts: Index, page numbering, pages authenticated by the authorised signatory
Form-I, fee, BOD resolution, composition affidavit, licence, PAN, incorporation
Proof that the technical source is registered (RC meeting reference)
Name of the FI registrant and the RC meeting that approved the import
ATR from an independent laboratory, and a sample for CIL

watch: Deemed registration of the technical, without a certificate, is not accepted

3.11 Three a.i. pre-mix - indigenous man.one: Data for making in India a ready-mix formulation with three active ingredients (336th RC, 2013).

pts: Every a.i. must come from a technical registered in India
Unregistered a.i. or source: separate full TIM / TI application
One clear analytical method separating all three a.i.
Data on chemical interaction among the a.i.; traceability of samples
Rationale for combining more than two a.i.
Two seasons, at least 3 agro-climatic conditions; cost-benefit ratio
Persistence / residues only if dose is higher, a new compound forms, or adjuvants differ

3.12 Three a.i. pre-mix - import.one: Data for importing a ready-mix formulation with three active ingredients (336th RC, 2013).

pts: Every a.i. must come from a technical registered in India; otherwise full TI data
One clear analytical separation method for all three a.i.
Consent letter from the source with its registration certificate, verifiable by the DNA
Authorised dealer certificate; GLP / ISO quality report with the first consignment
Same as 3.11: rationale, two seasons at 3 conditions, cost-benefit

3.13 TIM where formulation registered fo.one: Registering a technical for indigenous manufacture (TIM) when its formulation was registered for import without registering the technical (FI-WRT) (359th RC, 2015).

pts: Submit bridging data on shelf life and packaging, plus any data the RC asks (bio-efficacy, toxicity)
Technical in an FI-registered formulation is never 'deemed registered'
FI applicants must send a technical sample to CIL for pre-registration verification
Chemistry: composition, identity, impurities, chemical equivalence, process from step 1
Toxicity: acute studies, mutagenicity, medical data
Worker health records only if the manufacturing unit already exists

3.14 TIM by original registrant under FI.one: When the original Formulation Import registrant starts manufacturing the technical in India through technology transfer (389th RC, 2018).

pts: Form-I and the technology-transfer agreement
Consent from the original source to use the data submitted for FI
Undertaking: same specification, quality, composition and manufacturing process

watch: Toxicology for this case: Ames test only (see 3.1, p.87)

3.15 Manufacture Use Product (MUP).one: Data to register a Manufacture Use Product (MUP) for indigenous manufacture or import (399th RC).

pts: Technical not registered: full technical data in all disciplines, with sample and standards
Technical and source registered: only MUP data, plus a rationale in every folder
Proof the manufacturer is the actual producer, authorised dealer certificate, GLP report
Container compatibility, pilfer- and leak-proof closures, transport worthiness, storage performance

3.16 TI - New Source vs FIM-WRT / FI-WRT.one: Importing a technical from a new source when the molecule is already registered (as TI, FI-WRT or FIM-WRT) (470th RC, 2026).
nums: apply within this of the import permit to use it for data

pts: Office and factory address of the manufacturer with geotagging
Registration certificate in the exporting country (or proof of registered composition)
Detailed chemical equation, raw materials, flow sheet, effluent treatment
Bio-effectiveness and phytotoxicity on all registered formulations and crops
Residues on a representative crop of each group
Acute, sub-acute (28 and 90 days), mutagenicity, birds, earthworm, fish, bees
Not needed: neurotoxicity, reproduction, carcinogenicity, metabolism

watch: No exemption on bio-efficacy for the new source, in any condition
